name: Full superconducting fusion-magnet cold qualification at 4 K
plain_name: Full superconducting fusion-magnet cold qualification at 4 K
description: Cold-test a complete ITER superconducting magnet coil, a different scale and protocol from a short conductor sample.

sources.citation: ITER, World's largest superconducting magnet test facility now operational

requirements.rationale: ITER reports cooling the first coil to 4 K.
The full-coil cryochamber, current leads, support and protection system are indispensable.

missing_information: Full design current, coil-specific support/load cases, quench protection, helium pressure and availability are not certified. ITER states that in-machine conditions cannot all be reproduced.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
